svg.title: Beta-minus decay
svg.desc: Before: a parent nucleus. After: a daughter nucleus with one more proton and one fewer neutron, and an electron e− and an antineutrino moving away. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Beta-minus decay includes an electron antineutrino
In a nucleus: A stays fixed, Z increases by 1
n → p + e− + ν̅e. The weak interaction changes a neutron into a proton. Paths only separate the
labels; no particular energy sharing or recoil geometry is implied.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
